# Scenario: failed apply after compose change keeps the old container; next cycle
# retries without a new Git commit once the host dependency is fixed (REL-01).
#
# Cycle 1: deploy e2e-pend serving PEND_MARKER_V1.
# Cycle 2: Git compose → V2 + bad registry on host → login fails;
#          same container still serves V1 (update not applied).
# Cycle 3: fix .apinfra only (no Git) → pull/up recreates container; curl V2.
# Cycle 4: unchanged → stack still up on V2.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: apply pending baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-pend-web
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9977/
stdout 'PEND_MARKER_V1'

exec sh -c 'docker ps -aq --filter name=apinfra_e2e-pend-web > $WORK/old-cid'
exec sh -c 'test -s $WORK/old-cid'

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.v2.yml dev/e2e-pend/docker-compose.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'chore: compose content change for pending retry'
cd ..

# Bad registry so login fails after the compose change is staged.
cp .apinfra.bad-registry .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'logging into registry 127.0.0.1:1'
stderr 'docker login 127.0.0.1:1'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-pend-web
exec sh -c 'test "$(docker ps -aq --filter name=apinfra_e2e-pend-web)" = "$(cat $WORK/old-cid)"'
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9977/
stdout 'PEND_MARKER_V1'

# Recover host dependency without another Git commit.
cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-pend-web
exec sh -c 'test "$(docker ps -aq --filter name=apinfra_e2e-pend-web)" != "$(cat $WORK/old-cid)"'
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9977/
stdout 'PEND_MARKER_V2'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-pend-web
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9977/
stdout 'PEND_MARKER_V2'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- .apinfra.bad-registry --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
containerRegistryHost=127.0.0.1:1
containerRegistryUser=bad
containerRegistryToken=bad
dockerLoginTimeout=5s

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-pend
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9977
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-pend/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=PEND_MARKER_V1"]
-- compose.v2.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=PEND_MARKER_V2"]
-- .env --
